name: enil
description: LINE inside Claude Code: the enil TUI as a pane (chat list, chat view, reply, stickers, search, VIP), talking to the enil daemon locally or over ssh

host.title: Daemon host
host.description: ssh host where the enil daemon runs (e.g. home-server, a Host from ~/.ssh/config); empty = this machine

toast.title: Toast on new messages
toast.description: all: every message not in the open chat; vip: VIP chats only; off

toastSeconds.title: Toast seconds
toastSeconds.description: How long a new-message toast stays

notify.title: Desktop notification
notify.description: Native notification through your terminal: all, vip, or off

box.title: Unread in status line
box.description: statusline: show unread count (and waiting VIP chats) in the status line; off

images.title: Images
images.description: Draw avatars, photos and stickers as pictures (kitty graphics terminals); off draws text placeholders only
